signed-out.title: Signed out
signed-out.message: This account is signed out. Sign in again to retrieve its usage.

credential-expired.title: Sign-in expired
credential-expired.message: This account’s sign-in has expired. Sign in again to retrieve its usage.

no-credential.title: No sign-in found
no-credential.message: No saved sign-in was found for this account. Sign in to retrieve its usage.

http-401.title: Sign-in rejected
http-401.message: The provider rejected this account’s sign-in. Sign in again, then refresh.

http-403.title: Access denied
http-403.message: The provider denied access to this account’s usage. Check its access permissions, then refresh.

http-429.title: Usage service busy
http-429.message: The provider is limiting usage requests. Wait before refreshing.

unreachable.title: Cannot reach usage service
unreachable.message: The usage service could not be reached. Check your connection, then refresh.

not-json.title: Invalid usage response
not-json.message: The provider returned a response Unlimited could not read. Refresh to try again.

not-an-object.title: Invalid usage response
not-an-object.message: The provider returned a response Unlimited could not read. Refresh to try again.

no-limits.title: No usage limits reported
no-limits.message: The provider returned no usage limits for this account. Refresh to try again.

vendor-refused.title: Usage request refused
vendor-refused.message: The provider refused the usage request. Check this account with the provider, then refresh.

no-subscription.title: No subscription found
no-subscription.message: No active subscription was reported for this account. Check its plan with the provider.

http-5.title: Usage unavailable
http-5.message: The provider’s usage service is temporarily unavailable. Refresh to try again.

http-.title: Usage unavailable
http-.message: The provider refused the usage request ({reason}). Refresh to try again.

fallback.title: Usage unavailable
fallback.message: Usage could not be read from the provider (reason: {reason}). Refresh to try again.
